licence.description: "Open Government Licence – City of Kitchener", "Public record"

SourceDoc.description: A document the agents read: a staff report, an agenda, a budget book, a plan.

Citation.description: A quote that must appear, word for word after normalising, on that page.

verified.description: True only when every citation's quote was found on its page by the checker.

review.description: Staff review of this one statement.

Statement.description: One sentence a resident reads, with its sources.

label.description: "Property tax increase for an average home"

citation.description: absent only when kind is "computed" or "assumption"

formula.description: For computed figures: the formula in words, and the figure ids it uses.

Figure.description: A number on screen. Every figure is a link to its page.

instructions.description: plain words: "Register to speak by noon the Friday before"

plain.description: "Councillors discuss the draft budget. You can speak."

estimated.description: Worked out from a rule (e.g. "30 days after the proposal"), not published: show as "at the latest".

officialUrl.description: the official notice or agenda page

area.description: GeoJSON (WGS84) of the area the decision touches, for the map.

notices.description:
Hand-checked notices that change how to read the brief (e.g. a new rule on who
proposes the budget). Shown above the brief until staff regenerate it.

Decision.description: A proposed municipal decision. Hand-checked metadata; the brief is the agents'.

question.description: "How many buses route 7 will run after 9 pm"

scenarios.description: Times the access was computed for, e.g. "weekday-0800".

access.description: For each scenario and destination type, the share of the area's people (or origins) reaching one within the limit.

title.description: "No bus reaches Grand River Hospital by 8 am on Sundays from Mill Courtland"

layers.description: GeoJSON layers for the map: stops, gaps, destinations, isochrones.

method.description: the algorithm in plain words, with its reference

statements.description: Cited statements the transit-access specialist added in a brief.

partial.description: True when the brief has statements but no computed lens data.

TransitLens.description: Transit lens (challenge 2). Computed from GTFS + destinations by lenses/transit.

figures.description: upfront, annual operating, annual maintenance, renewal, emissions, carbon price

tracked.description: false where no public data shows this stage

name.description: "Parking lot east of Fairway Rd and Hwy 8"

score.description: 0..100, higher is better, from the stated weights

ConstructionSite.description:
Construction scout. Agents scout candidate sites for excavation and a tunnel boring
machine (TBM) launch portal or shaft along a line, lay out the bores and the
geotechnical boreholes, and stage the work step by step with illustrative renders.
Always a scenario for engineers and staff to evaluate: agents never pick the site.

scenario.description: label: "Illustrative scenario: not a Region plan"

alignmentSource.description: where the line came from, with licence

proposed.description: site ids the scout ranks first, for staff to evaluate

profile.description: Long-section along the alignment, for the profile drawing. Metres.

readingGrade.description: Flesch-Kincaid grade of the summary + impacts

next.description: next event with participation, if any

payload.description: The content. null once purged under the city's records retention by-law.

payloadHash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the payload. The chain hashes this, not the payload, so content can be purged and the chain still verifies.

hash.description: sha256(prevHash + canonical JSON of {seq, at, actor, kind, decisionId, payloadHash})

purged.description: Set when the payload was purged: when, why, and the record.purged entry that did it.

legacyHash.description: Entries written before payload hashing: their original hash (sha256(prevHash + canonical JSON of {seq, at, actor, kind, decisionId, payload})).

LogEntry.description: The log: append-only, each entry's hash covers the previous one's.

offline.description: Answered without a model (the model was unreachable): from the brief's checked statements.

replay.description: Replayed from a saved real run (the answer cache): when it was answered, and the label shown.
